text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Utilizing the VR Umulator?
choice_data_list: Exactly! I was wondering if we could make better use of it!

text_block_list.text:
During a meeting with Narita Taishin,
I share that I'm looking into utilizing VR equipment more in training.

Leading up to the upcoming GⅠ race,
it would be ideal to conduct some
serious race simulations as well.
choice_data_list: I want to polish it up a bit more, so bear with me!
I want to polish it up a bit more, so give me a moment!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...
Well, fine by me. Do whatever you want.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
......Huh.
VR tech has really come a long way...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ("By entering race conditions and runner data in detail, you can run a remarkably authentic race simulation"... huh.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(Yeah, if I wanna make the most of this,
I'm definitely gonna need data...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Data... data, huh...
...Ah, in that case—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: —Ah, there they are.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Need something.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Mm, I just wanted to negotiate a bit.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: To be blunt: I want data. Nakayama Racecourse, Turf 2000m. Give me as much past runner data and race development history as possible.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...
—Purpose. And what do I get in return?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"I'll run race simulations in the VR Umalator.
In return... I give them my current data."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph. If it's just the past five years or so,
I can put it together right away. —Still, give me a bit more.
Throw in the simulation data too.
The VR-based training plan has mostly come together. Today, I plan to give VR a test run during our regular training session.
choice_data_list: The goal is just to collect current data, so take it easy!
The goal is just to collect current data, so take it easy!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Mm.
Anything's fine, just tell me the menu.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, you're just getting started?
Perfect timing.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I finished reviewing the data you asked for.
I'll give it to you now.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Huh? We're doing a VR simulation, right.
It's past data for that.
Aren't you gonna use it now?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: W-Wait, that's—

"Could it be... with an eye toward using VR,
Narita Taishin took the initiative to gather data
all on her own...?!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Wha— No, you've got it wrong!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...I handed it over, alright?

It was precisely because of her drive that she studied VR and gathered the right data.
Thanks to her, the quality of our training is bound to improve.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Nggghhh, shut up!
Cut that out, you're suffocating me!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I mean, taking action for my own training
is completely normal and expected...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, hurry up and give me instructions!
You're gonna train me, right?!
choice_data_list: I'll try not to get too carried away.

text_block_list.text:
Since she seems so motivated,
maybe it'd be a good idea to take the leap
and set up a mock race.
choice_data_list: Let's put the data we got to use right away!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
~~gh, like I said! Stop acting so suffocatingly
intense already...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...*Sigh*.
Whatever. I'm fine with a mock race.
Just get it set up quickly; I'll go warm up.

Afterward, despite grumbling a bit, she tackled it seriously and delivered a great run.
Let's polish her running based on the data we gathered here!

If I make too much of a fuss, I might sour her mood.
For today, let's just stick to the plan.
choice_data_list: Alright, once you're warmed up, start with a 15-15.
Alright, once you're warmed up, start with a 15-15.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ……Your face is too loud.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Wipe that smirk off your face already.
...Alright, let's start with warm-ups.
Even while complaining, Narita Taishin takes her training seriously. I was reminded once again: she really is amazingly admirable!
